correctness.rationale: The Erlang-chain modal Jacobian factors exactly as (z+X)(z+M)(z+B)^(k+1)+C. Strict monotonicity of phase and modulus yields the complete crossing count and ordering, while Re L(iw)>0 gives simple transversal crossings; the fixed-mean limit follows from the exponential limit of the chain factor.
